name: mio-integration-timing-check-template
notes: The G5 timing check: the WHOLE quarter packet (receipt, bounded inputs and calendar unchanged) with ONE decision week listed in decision_weeks; every other week records week_not_selected and solves nothing. It holds the combined arm and its control and is run once per pre-registered week, each in an account that holds its deposits and no open book. Timing, solver status and peak RSS only: such a document is never evidence (`check_document_not_evidence`). The week set is ADR-0312 section 7's plus three solved weeks per quarter, restricted for the calibrated arm to weeks with a warm map. Limits: median solved-week time at most 1.5x the control's, no week that solved in the control may time out. Template, not a run config: nothing here is approved to run. RE-ENTRY Do-not list obeyed: development seal 2021-07-01 (no decision, fill, quote, mark or settlement at or past it; 2021Q3 and later never), no 2024+ data, no run log read, agents report counts, hashes and verdict words only. Every arm is a research arm BESIDE the nine locked formulations (A0010) on a NEW method id; the base formulation is w1_010_shock10_lp, its spec copied verbatim; locked_method_ids is the nine of the queue config. Copy this file to a new name, replace every item of `placeholders` and nothing else. PREREQUISITES in order: (1) diagnostics first, no solve: the ADR-0310 Greeks diagnostics on the saved selection-quarter runs, `PYTHONPATH=.:children/index_options python -m dskit.pipeline run <mio-greeks-<quarter>.json> --asof <date>`; (2) the arm is declared in docs/decisioning/attempts.jsonl BEFORE its first solve (family mio_integration); (3) `PYTHONPATH=.:children/index_options python -m dskit.pipeline validate <doc>.json`. RUN COMMAND (repository root, one document at a time): `PYTHONPATH=.:children/index_options python -m dskit.pipeline run <doc>.json --asof <quarter end>` (2021-06-30 for 2021Q2, then 2021-03-31 for 2021Q1, then 2020-03-31 for 2020Q1; exit 0 ran, 1 error or a refusal code, 3 halted). EVIDENCE: only the statuses `closed` or `insufficient` exist on the selection quarters (ADR-0313 section E); a quarter counts for a calibrated arm only with at least min_warm_weeks warm decision weeks; nothing here adopts an arm.

placeholders.meaning: exactly one pre-registered decision date of the quarter (2021-04-05 below is a valid-format placeholder)
the onboarding pin of the published edge maps (acquire once, after the walk's read words are PASS)
the explicit StudyProtocolControl freeze of the quarter packet (run.template.json's substitutions)

study_overlay.notes: Deep-merged into the frozen study's domain.params (and domain.sources) at freeze time; `clocks` keeps every other key of the frozen document and only pins tail_end_before.

edge_maps.pin: PLACEHOLDER: the onboarding pin of the published edge maps (never hand-written)
